meta_description: Pek Plumbing & Heating Ltd in Derby offers emergency plumbing, heating repairs, and boiler services across Derbyshire. Fast response, fair prices. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Derby? We arrive same day, diagnose fast, and fix right first time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full system overhauls, we handle every plumbing and heating job with expertise and care.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages don't wait—neither do we. We're on call 24/7 to stop the damage and restore your water supply fast.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating reliable with annual services and rapid repair calls. We fix most faults same day, with parts carried on the van.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New system or upgrade? We design, install, and commission modern heating to cut your bills and keep you warm all winter.

services.title: Radiator & Pipe Work
services.desc: From replacing old radiators to installing pipework in new builds, we balance comfort, efficiency, and cost.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Full design and installation for new bathrooms and kitchens—we coordinate with your builders and guarantee a watertight finish.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks waste water and money. We locate the source using modern diagnostics and repair it before damage spreads.

about_pullquote: I started Pek because I hated seeing customers ripped off for simple fixes.
about_para_1: Pek Plumbing & Heating was founded on a simple idea: turn up on time, do the job right, and charge a fair price. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation across Derby and surrounding areas for honest work and rapid emergency response. Every member of the team is trained and holds current qualifications—no shortcuts, no cowboys.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we listen first and fix second. Whether it's a midnight pipe burst or a planned boiler replacement, we treat your home with respect and give you a clear price before we start work. Repeat customers make up over 60% of our work—that says everything.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Pek

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe just before Christmas. Called Pek at 10pm and they were here by 11. Didn't even flinch at the late hour. Fixed it properly, tidied up after themselves, and the price was fair. Absolute lifesaver. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Pek for boiler servicing for four years now. They're reliable, never let you down, and actually explain what they're doing instead of just talking at you. Came out in February to fix a fault we didn't even know about. Saved us a fortune in the long run.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: New bathroom installation. The lads were professional, respectful of our home, and finished on schedule. Plumbing is hidden but you just know it's been done right. Better than the cowboys I called before. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David P.
